RCD.Settings.ShowVitalsHint: Display HP and MP bars on dock cards. The Study gate on enemy vitals still applies — this only hides what you could already see.
RCD.Settings.ShowTurnMarkerHint: Ring the acting combatant's token on the canvas — a blood halo for the Rippers, a bone-iron one for enemies, with the turn caption beneath. Turn it off to keep the map clean.
